Q: Is there a concept in Python 3 which integrates with the while-statement like an iterator does with the for-statement? A:

I don't think the OP is unaware of how a for loop can be implemented with a while loop.

Right, I didn't mean to imply that. I was trying to illustrate how for is higher-level than while.

The question is about how the specific code pattern can be structured in a way that is both readable and easy to use (i.e. without an explicit, separate initialization in the user's code).

Right, and I did address this: "... you probably want for. That might involve writing a wrapper function or a helper class. I don't have specifics, this is just a pointer."

Q: Unity game UI distortions on the phone A:

I solved the problem. The issue was in my script. I had included the following code:

Screen.SetResolution(Screen.currentResolution.width,
                     Screen.currentResolution.height,
                     true);

After removing it, the game worked correctly.

Q: Why did my github merge go in the wrong direction? A:

I've seen this a few times it's definitely a GitHub bug or quirk. You try to update a branch, there's a merge conflict, you resolve it and then it offers to commit back to main/master. You think it's only commiting that little merge conflict but it commits the entire branch into master.

https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/177004

Q: Seeking clarification on cookies given to a user from a hosted RTD website A:

This has been answered for me, and, in 2026, RTD don't directly store any cookies for public documentation projects. Backend analytics tracking does not use cookies: it uses page views to track visits.

Q: Unity IOS build Game A:

This error usually appears when the Firebase version pinned in the Podfile doesn’t match what the Unity Firebase SDK expects.
In Unity iOS builds it’s generally better not to lock Firebase to a specific version and let CocoaPods resolve compatible dependencies on its own.

I’d recommend updating CocoaPods, removing the fixed Firebase version from the Podfile, deleting Pods and Podfile.lock, and running a clean pod install again. Also make sure all Firebase Unity packages are on the same version and that the iOS deployment target meets Firebase’s minimum requirements.

This kind of mismatch between Unity plugins and CocoaPods specs is pretty common and is usually resolved after a clean reinstall with aligned versions.
